title: Two Open Questions
eyebrow: Design questions · design loop fixes (parent issue #457) · asked during Build

short.lead: Your build plan answers raised two points I should not settle myself. First, you set one 16 MB limit for the whole page, and asked that files over it still be included rather than cut. There is more than one way to do that. Second, the Copy my reply button failed for you, because the app's file viewer blocks the browser's copy function. The button then only selects the text. Meanwhile #458 (Remove the judgement-call exception) is being built, because neither question touches it.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes and what it needs from you.
items: Include files past the page limit
One of the routes in the first choice, built into #462 (Pictures inside the page).
Make Copy my reply work for you
A new sub-issue under #457, built after #461 (Page check blocks again).

changes: Cloud pages are published, not sent as files
A rule for this already exists, and it is switched off.

Since issue #343, a reply in a cloud session must link a published claude.ai page, not a local file. Since issue #309, the page check has only reported a broken rule and has not blocked anything, so the rule never stopped me, and I sent you local files instead of a published page this session.
#461 (Page check blocks again) makes the published-page rule block again in cloud sessions. This page is published as a claude.ai page, so you can try its button now.
I can't test from here whether the browser's copy function works on a published claude.ai page. The quality-check step of the build tests it on your phone.
choices: eye
How should files past the 16 MB page limit still be included?
A
As separate files of the same published page

Pictures go inside the page until it reaches 16 MB. The rest are published with it as separate files: each can be up to 15 MB, and one publish carries up to 64 MB. The page check refuses a publish that leaves one out. You open one link, as today.
B
Split into linked pages
The builder makes a second page, then a third, each under 16 MB, with Next links between them. Every picture stays inside its page, but one proposal becomes several links.
C
Shrink pictures until they fit
Large pictures are re-saved at lower quality until the page fits. Nothing is left out, but the pictures you see are not the originals.
A keeps one link and the original files, and the 15 MB per-file and 64 MB per-publish limits are large enough for every page we have made so far.
hand
How should the Copy my reply button be made to work?
A
Publish every page and add a second copy method

Pages are published as claude.ai pages. The button also tries a second copy method that more viewers allow. If both fail, the reply shows in a text box that selects itself in one tap, ready for your phone's Copy.
B
Only add the second copy method
Pages can still be sent as files, and the button tries harder. Whether it works in the app's file viewer is unknown until you try it.
C
Only publish every page
The button is unchanged, and it works only if published pages allow copying.
A covers both routes, so the button has the best chance on your phone, and the one-tap box saves you selecting by hand if it still fails.
